# Wildly Calm

> Wildly Calm runs small outdoor retreats for men in their twenties and thirties,
> from Sydney, NSW: three days somewhere wild, something hard to do together, then
> the honest conversations that don't happen at the pub. It is a NSW not-for-profit
> incorporated association run by three co-founders, Lockie Ranson, Kieran Maguire
> and Sam Davis. Peers, not counsellors: it is not therapy.

- Next retreat: Barrington River Men's Retreat, canoeing the Barrington River, NSW,
  Friday 4 to Sunday 6 December 2026.
- Contact: Instagram @wildlycalmretreats or wildlycalmretreats@gmail.com.
- Need to talk to someone now: Lifeline 13 11 14, MensLine Australia 1300 78 99 78, emergency 000.

## Pages

- [Wildly Calm](https://wildlycalm.org/): what a weekend looks like, past retreats, the guiding principles and the next retreat.
- [Barrington River Men's Retreat](https://wildlycalm.org/retreats/barrington-river.html): the next retreat, 4 to 6 December 2026.
- [Broughton Island, March 2025](https://wildlycalm.org/retreats/broughton-island.html): March 2025: a handful of mates sea-kayaked out to Broughton Island off Port Stephens, speared fish for dinner and camped in the rocks. Where Wildly Calm started.
- [Camp Bunya, October 2025](https://wildlycalm.org/retreats/camp-bunya.html): October 2025, our first men's retreat: river days in kayaks, yoga on the grass and sleeping bags round the fire.
- [Croajingalong, February 2026](https://wildlycalm.org/retreats/croajingalong.html): February 2026: a busload of Sydney men, three days of coastal hiking and off-grid camping in Croajingalong National Park, and deep listening round the fire.
- [The Snowies, September 2026](https://wildlycalm.org/retreats/the-snowies.html): September 2026: hiking in the snow near Thredbo, breathwork and yoga, show and tell by the fire, then a sauna and an ice bath.
